assumptions: 'Success rate' means attempt-level success rate: successful attempts divided by all attempts, with each retry counted as a separate attempt. Order-level and technical rates are shown alongside.

facts.text: Overall attempt success rate fell 3.1pp from 90.1% to 87.0% between the baseline period (83,268 attempts) and the 17-18 September window (22,790 attempts).
The performance drop concentrated heavily in Kestrel Bank, which recorded a success rate of 78.5% compared to 90.0% in the baseline window, contributing -3.11pp to the total change.

Within Kestrel Bank, declines were isolated to card channels: debit card success rate fell 30.11pp from 86.4% to 56.3%, credit card fell 28.71pp from 88.6% to 59.9%, and card EMI fell 23.87pp from 80.7% to 56.8%.
For Kestrel Bank card transactions, technical timeout failure ACQ_TIMEOUT rose by 32.02 per 100 attempts, climbing from 0.26 to 32.27 per 100 attempts and totaling 803 failures.
A data-quality audit identified 0 findings across attempt records, dimensions, and timestamps.

response.headline: Overall attempt success rate fell 3.1pp from 90.1% to 87.0% on 17-18 September, driven by sharp declines across card payment methods processed via Kestrel Bank.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Examine gateway latency records and request error logs with Kestrel Bank's technical support team for the period covering 17-18 September.
hypotheses.rationale: The failure surge was concentrated entirely within card transactions on Kestrel Bank and dominated by ACQ_TIMEOUT, which increased by 32.02 per 100 attempts.
hypotheses.text: Kestrel Bank experienced severe technical latency or an outage on its card acquiring processing infrastructure.

recommendations.linked_fact_or_hypothesis: Kestrel Bank experienced severe technical latency or an outage on its card acquiring processing infrastructure.
recommendations.rationale: ACQ_TIMEOUT accounted for 803 failed card attempts during the disruption.
recommendations.text: Raise an incident ticket with Kestrel Bank to review gateway timeout errors on card endpoints.

recommendations.rationale: Debit card and credit card success rates dropped by 30.11pp and 28.71pp respectively during the affected period.
